{
  "obligations": [
    {
      "id": "D1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "entity",
      "role": "declaration",
      "statement": "Deliver program.vscore.json containing exactly one admitted typed entry named solve, expressed as canonical vscore/0.3 source under normative Lean vscore-semantics/0.3 and data-pipeline/0.3 serialization. Its input represents the JSON object {n,m,a,b} and its result represents a single exact mathematical integer. Input n is an integer from 0 through 500, m is a positive integer, and a and b are arbitrary signed integers without a magnitude bound. The specified structure and ordering are preserved. Arithmetic and any strings follow the normative unbounded-integer and Unicode-scalar semantics.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["delivery artifact", "typed solve entry", "input and output representations"],
      "dependencies": [],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "The delivered artifact is program.vscore.json and admits exactly one typed entry named solve under the specified source, semantics and serialization profiles.",
        "The typed input represents n, m, a and b; the serialized result is an exact integer with the requested structure and ordering.",
        "No finite magnitude bound is imposed on a or b; magnitudes such as 10^30 are supported.",
        "Any string values use Unicode scalar values and scalar-codepoint lexicographic ordering."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C2", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Artifact and entry identity."},
        {"clause_id": "C3", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Typed JSON correspondence."},
        {"clause_id": "C7", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Input fields and mathematical domains."},
        {"clause_id": "C12", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Canonical source and normative profiles."},
        {"clause_id": "C13", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Structure and ordering preservation."},
        {"clause_id": "C16", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Mathematical integer representation."},
        {"clause_id": "C17", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Normative string semantics."},
        {"clause_id": "C23", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Preserve requirement identity."},
        {"clause_id": "C29", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "D1 declaration identity and required flag."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "A1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "precondition",
      "role": "assumption",
      "statement": "The supplier provides inputs satisfying the specified JSON schema with integer n, m, a and b, 0 <= n <= 500 and m > 0. The integers a and b have no additional bounds, and no additional preconditions are imposed.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["supplied solve inputs"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "Each supplied input satisfies the specified schema, 0 <= n <= 500 and m > 0.",
        "The assumption permits every signed integer a and b and adds no other restriction."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C5", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Explicit input-supplier assurance."},
        {"clause_id": "C7", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Stated schema and bounds."},
        {"clause_id": "C18", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "No added preconditions."},
        {"clause_id": "C29", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "A1 assumption identity and required flag."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "N1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "explicit_non_goal",
      "role": "exclusion",
      "statement": "Behavior for malformed inputs outside the stated schema and bounds is not required.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["malformed inputs"],
      "dependencies": [],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["No functional obligation is asserted for malformed input."],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C6", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Malformed-input behavior excluded."},
        {"clause_id": "C29", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "N1 exclusion identity and required flag."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "O1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "postcondition",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "For every input satisfying A1, solve returns the exact integer sum Σ(i=0 to n-1) floor((a*i+b)/m). Each floor is the unique integer q satisfying q*m <= a*i+b < (q+1)*m, so rounding is toward negative infinity even for negative numerators. For n=0 the result is zero. The admitted implementation universally refines this complete mathematical specification and reproduces both public examples.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["all inputs satisfying A1"],
      "dependencies": [
        {"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"},
        {"id": "A1", "relation": "assumes"}
      ],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "For every valid n, m, a and b, the returned integer equals Σ(i=0 to n-1) floor((a*i+b)/m).",
        "For every summand, its quotient q satisfies q*m <= a*i+b < (q+1)*m.",
        "For every valid m, a and b, n=0 produces zero.",
        "Input {a:-2,b:1,m:3,n:4} produces -4; input {a:100,b:-99,m:7,n:0} produces 0.",
        "Universal implementation refinement is established; example agreement alone is insufficient."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C8", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Exact universal floor-sum function."},
        {"clause_id": "C9", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Signed floor semantics."},
        {"clause_id": "C10", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Empty sum."},
        {"clause_id": "C19", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Preservation of public examples."},
        {"clause_id": "C20", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Concrete outputs and universal refinement."},
        {"clause_id": "C22", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Functional meaning unchanged."},
        {"clause_id": "C26", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Complete mathematical guarantee and refinement."},
        {"clause_id": "C27", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Examples cannot replace universal proof."},
        {"clause_id": "C29", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "O1 guarantee identity and required flag."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "O2",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "postcondition",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "The canonical solve entry has total, pure and deterministic admitted typed execution under normative Lean vscore-semantics/0.3 and data-pipeline/0.3. Every input satisfying A1 yields the specified result representation with exact structure and ordering, without additional input restrictions. Universal implementation refinement and delivery assurance are evaluated at the requested Tier 2 restricted_source vscore/0.3 boundary.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["admitted typed execution", "serialized input/output correspondence", "restricted-source delivery"],
      "dependencies": [
        {"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"},
        {"id": "A1", "relation": "assumes"}
      ],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "Admitted typed execution terminates with a result and is pure and deterministic.",
        "Every valid input has the required serialized output representation with exact structure and ordering.",
        "No additional input bound or precondition is needed.",
        "The artifact and universal refinement satisfy the requested Tier 2 restricted_source backend vscore/0.3 verification obligations, without asserting a lifecycle state in this proposal."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C2", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Admitted solve delivery."},
        {"clause_id": "C3", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Typed representation guarantee."},
        {"clause_id": "C12", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Normative execution and serialization."},
        {"clause_id": "C13", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Exact representation preservation."},
        {"clause_id": "C14", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Totality, purity and determinism."},
        {"clause_id": "C18", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Full specified domain."},
        {"clause_id": "C21", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Canonical restricted-source revision."},
        {"clause_id": "C24", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Revised typed pure source properties."},
        {"clause_id": "C25", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Retain prior delivery assurance."},
        {"clause_id": "C26", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Universal implementation refinement."},
        {"clause_id": "C29", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "O2 identity, required flag and requested endpoint."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "S1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "safety_property",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "The solve source performs no external I/O, does not read benchmark files, and does not mutate input values. Its admitted typed execution is pure, using a language without external-effect constructors.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["solve source", "all admitted typed executions"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "No admitted execution performs external I/O or reads benchmark files.",
        "Input values remain immutable throughout execution.",
        "The admitted source uses the specified effect-free language semantics."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C4", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "No I/O or benchmark access."},
        {"clause_id": "C14", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Pure execution."},
        {"clause_id": "C15", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Immutability and absence of effect constructors."},
        {"clause_id": "C29", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "S1 safety identity and required flag."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "S2",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "safety_property",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "All arithmetic used to compute the floor sum is exact unbounded mathematical integer arithmetic without floating point, finite-width overflow, or precision loss.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["all floor-sum arithmetic", "all inputs satisfying A1"],
      "dependencies": [
        {"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"},
        {"id": "A1", "relation": "assumes"}
      ],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "No floating-point arithmetic is used.",
        "All intermediate arithmetic and the returned sum use exact unbounded integer semantics.",
        "Arbitrarily large signed a and b introduce no overflow or rounding loss."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C8", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Exact sum."},
        {"clause_id": "C11", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Floating point prohibited."},
        {"clause_id": "C16", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Unbounded mathematical integer arithmetic."},
        {"clause_id": "C29", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "S2 safety identity and required flag."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "N2",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "explicit_non_goal",
      "role": "exclusion",
      "statement": "Runtime campaigns and machine-code, compiler, runtime and physical-resource assurance are outside the requested scope. Assurance is limited to normative restricted-source execution, explicitly trusting natural-language correspondence, host tooling, the pinned Lean kernel, hashing and OS/hardware.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["verification boundary", "excluded assurance and campaigns"],
      "dependencies": [],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "No runtime campaign is required.",
        "No machine-code, compiler, runtime or physical-resource assurance is asserted.",
        "The assurance boundary records the explicitly trusted correspondence, tooling, kernel, hashing and OS/hardware."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C30", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Runtime campaigns excluded."},
        {"clause_id": "C31", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Restricted-source boundary and explicit trust."},
        {"clause_id": "C32", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Excluded assurance layers."}
      ]
    }
  ],
  "category_review": {
    "entities": "D1 declares the canonical artifact, admitted solve entry, typed JSON correspondence and normative value semantics.",
    "preconditions": "A1 records only the explicit supplied-input schema and bounds.",
    "postconditions": "O1 specifies the complete universal signed floor sum; O2 specifies total pure deterministic typed execution and serialization delivery.",
    "invariants": "Input immutability is covered by S1; no other invariant is stated.",
    "safety_properties": "S1 excludes effects and mutation; S2 requires exact unbounded arithmetic without floating point.",
    "liveness_properties": "Execution totality is covered by O2.",
    "resource_constraints": "No physical-resource constraint or assurance is requested.",
    "error_semantics": "Malformed-input behavior is excluded by N1.",
    "explicit_non_goals": "N1 excludes malformed-input behavior; N2 excludes runtime campaigns and assurance outside the restricted-source boundary.",
    "ambiguities": "None requiring resolution."
  },
  "clauses": [

    {"clause_id": "C24", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O2"], "note": ""},

  ],
  "assumptions": [
    {
      "id": "A1",

  ],
